criteria.text: Give the local chat a light-first direction from AD-4 in KNOWLEDGE/architecture.md, sections Palette and typography, Conversation layout, and Dark treatment. Use page #f7f4ee, panel #ffffff, accent #b94f38, focus #8d3326, a 70rem content maximum and dark canvas #202833. Observe the conversation list and active thread in rendered mobile 390x844 and desktop 1440x1000 views in light and dark themes, with a clear active marker, visible keyboard focus and no horizontal overflow. The browser command is planned, not yet run. Serves R-1.

Preserve local conversation selection, message display, and sending: selecting either seeded conversation changes the active thread, sending non-empty text appends it to that thread, and empty text is ignored. Confirm by node --test; pass when TC-CHAT passes. Serves R-2.
